name: Jordan
self_text: I'm Jordan, a Nigerian in my mid 20s. When I'm not gazing at the stars with my amateur astronomy gear, I'm usually out with my Nikon. I love the way photography captures a fleeting moment in time. I'm looking for a relaxed photo walk at a moderate pace. I'm free on Saturday afternoon or Sunday morning. Regarding our time together, I'm fine with not taking portraits of each other and I'm not looking for any post-processing lessons this time. I also have no interest in gear debates.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available either Saturday afternoon or Sunday morning. I'd strongly prefer that you are into a relaxed photo walk, though I won't rule you out over it. It would be nice if we have no gear debates or if gear talk is fine but not the point, but that's no big deal.
